guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: bookable minutes a day, set-up time, wanted utilisation, notice hours, deposit and the no-show target.
Check Team, Resources, Services and Working Days. They hold the people, the chairs, the services with minutes, price and deposit and the days each technician works.

Enter each appointment on Appointments with its date, times, technician, chair, service, client, source, status and deposit. The end check, the lead time bucket and the phone numbers calculate themselves.

Keep Technician Days up to date with the appointments, booked minutes and bookable minutes of each day. Utilisation, free minutes and the over capacity flag show where to sell more and where to move a client.
Log every no-show and late cancel on No-show and Late Cancel Log and every deposit on Deposits, with its state: asked for, held, used, kept or refunded.
Use Waiting List, Open Slots and Same-Day Changes to fill free time and to record what changed on the day. Overbooking Checks and Time Off keep the book safe.
Read Reminder Schedule and Booking Rules for the reminders and the notice and fee rules you follow. Check your own local rules before you charge a fee.
Weekday Pattern, Time-of-Day Demand, Booking Sources, Month Summary and Seasons show when the studio is busy and when it is quiet.
Use the 14 calculators to check a day, find a slot, test a reminder, plan a day, price a no-show and forecast the next 14 days.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Appointment Dashboard and Charts every week: appointments, utilisation, no-shows, deposits, open slots filled and the technician days over capacity.

listing.title: Appointment Book Excel Template for Lash, Brow, Nail and Skin Care Studios: Chair Capacity, No-show Log, Deposits, Waiting List
listing.headline: Fill every chair hour and stop losing money to no-shows
listing.description:
Run the daily appointment book of a small lash, brow, nail and skin care studio in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner and a front desk who book 3 to 5 technicians, employees and booth renters (technicians who rent a chair and keep their own takings), on 4 chairs and a treatment room. The Appointments sheet lists each booking with its times, technician, chair, service, client, source, status, price and deposit and checks the end time and the lead time. Technician Days adds booked and bookable minutes for each day and works out utilisation (the share of bookable minutes that are sold), free minutes and overbooked days.

No-show and Late Cancel Log records each lost appointment, where a no-show is a client who does not come and does not cancel and a late cancel is a cancellation inside the notice time, with the revenue lost and the deposit kept. Deposits tracks every deposit from asked for to used, kept or refunded. Waiting List, Open Slots, Same-Day Changes, Overbooking Checks and Time Off keep the book full and safe, and Reminder Schedule, Booking Rules, Weekday Pattern, Time-of-Day Demand, Booking Sources, Month Summary and Seasons show where the demand is.

14 calculators cover chair capacity, a next free slot finder, overbooking, the cost of no-shows, late-cancel fees, waiting list value, booking windows, reminder timing, day plans, set-up time, a 14-day capacity forecast, walk-ins, day-off cover and a no-show rate grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages to clients, technicians, the front desk and the owner.

This is part two of the Beauty Studio suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you run the book and does not give legal, tax or health advice: check your own local rules.

de.Log every no-show and late cancel on No-: Protokollieren Sie jeden verpassten Termin und jede verspätete Absage am Protokoll über Nichterscheinen und verspätete Stornierung sowie jede Anzahlung unter Einzahlungen mit ihrem Status: angefordert, gehalten, verwendet, einbehalten oder zurückerstattet.
de.Use Waiting List, Open Slots and Same-Da: Verwenden Sie Warteliste, Offene Slots und Änderungen am selben Tag, um die freie Zeit zu füllen und aufzuzeichnen, was sich an dem Tag geändert hat. Überbuchungsschecks und Auszeit bewahren das Buch sicher auf.

de.Use the 14 calculators to check a day, f: Use the 14 calculators to check a day, find a slot, test a reminder, plan a day, price a missed appointment and forecast the next 14 days.
de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, folgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Text mit den bereits eingetragenen Details zu senden.
de.Read the Appointment Dashboard and Chart: Read the Termin-Dashboard and Charts every week: appointments, utilisation, missed appointments, deposits, open slots filled and the technician days over capacity.
de.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle Auswahllisten dieser Datei. Ändere hier einen Eintrag, und er wird in allen Tabellen übernommen.
de.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wird anhand deiner Tabellen aktualisiert. Ändere das Jahr, um frühere Daten anzusehen.
